content.text:
The assembly below places all eight parts as a chained pin joint: base → lower arm → elbow plate → upper arm → head plate → L-bracket → shade → bulb. I worked the joints out from matching hole and boss positions, so the connections should hold, but the orientations of the pivoting parts are a judgement call.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1376 768">
  <use href="#kit-base" transform="translate(150 660)"/>
  <use href="#kit-lower_arm" transform="translate(442.31 339.67) rotate(15)"/>
  <use href="#kit-elbow_plate" transform="translate(501.01 446.35) rotate(-133.3)"/>
  <use href="#kit-upper_arm" transform="translate(488.65 330.66) rotate(-33.02)"/>
  <use href="#kit-head_plate" transform="translate(817.36 252.59)"/>
  <use href="#kit-l_bracket" transform="translate(833.39 369.81) rotate(-65)"/>
  <use href="#kit-shade" transform="translate(741.38 555.06) rotate(-90)"/>
  <use href="#kit-bulb" transform="translate(933.36 368.07) rotate(79.85)"/>
</svg>
```

How the parts are joined:

- **Base → lower arm:** the lower arm's bottom pin sits on the base's pivot hole at the right end of the base. The base stays upright and level on the ground line.
- **Lower arm → elbow plate:** the lower arm's top pin goes to the elbow plate's large corner hole. The elbow's third hole is left unused, since the spring that would use it is not in the kit.
- **Elbow plate → upper arm:** the small-hole corner of the elbow takes the upper arm's near pin.
- **Upper arm → head plate:** the upper arm's far pin goes to the head plate's small upper-left hole. The head's bottom corner hole is left unused.
- **Head plate → L-bracket:** the bracket's long-leg boss sits on the head plate's right corner hole.
- **L-bracket → shade:** the bracket's other boss sits on the shade's socket. The shade is turned mouth-down.
- **Shade → bulb:** the bulb's contact tip is inserted into the same socket. The bulb's globe is centred on the shade axis, tilted about 27° from it, because the socket sits off-axis.

Parts I could not verify from the drawings:

- The choice of which bracket end goes to the head's right corner, and which elbow corner the lower arm uses.
- The orientation of the elbow plate and head plate, which the kit does not fix. I chose a plausible pose.
- The bulb's tilt relative to the shade. I placed the globe on the shade axis, which I judged the most physically sensible option.
